name: Viginti – Twenty Client
subtitle: Mobile CRM, native & offline
description:
Your Twenty CRM, finally in your pocket. Fast, offline, and beautifully native.

Viginti is a native iPhone, iPad and Mac client for Twenty (twenty.com), the open-source CRM. Connect your self-hosted workspace or Twenty Cloud and take contacts, companies, opportunities, tasks, notes and custom objects with you.

No web view. No compromise. Just Apple-native speed, gestures and design on top of the CRM your team already loves.

YOUR WHOLE CRM, NATIVELY
- Everything from Twenty, including custom objects.
- Powerful search with advanced filters, sorting and grouping.
- My Day dashboard: what's due today and what's overdue, the moment you open the app.
- Saved views and multiple workspaces.

ON THE ROAD
- Map: your companies and contacts on a map - see who's nearby.
- Call follow-up: after a call from Viginti, log a note, voice note or follow-up task right away.
- Your next meeting with its contacts, open tasks and deals - also as a Live Activity in the Dynamic Island.

BUILT FOR SPEED, DESIGNED FOR iOS
- 100% SwiftUI with native gestures, swipe actions, haptics and dark mode.
- iPad-optimized with keyboard shortcuts. Runs on Mac, too.
- Available in 7 languages.
- Helpful tips at the right moment.

REAL OFFLINE SUPPORT
- Read your CRM with no connection: cached data is always available.
- Edit offline and Viginti syncs automatically when you're back online, with conflict handling that never silently drops your work.

CAPTURE LEADS IN SECONDS
- Business-card scanner: point your camera, get a new contact.
- Document scanner: attach scans straight to a record.
- Voice notes, transcribed on-device and turned into clean notes with suggested tasks by Apple Intelligence.
- Share links, text and contact cards to Viginti from other apps.

STAY IN THE LOOP
- Push notifications for what matters in your workspace.
- Home & Lock Screen widgets with your real CRM data.
- Siri & Spotlight know your contacts, companies, opportunities and tasks - even "this contact" on screen.
- Shortcuts: create a record, complete a task or scan a card by voice.
- Calendar sync for your tasks.

PRIVATE AND SECURE BY DESIGN
- App Lock with Face ID / Touch ID.
- Secure sign-in via OAuth / PKCE; credentials stay in the iOS Keychain, never in plain text.
- Your own self-hosted Twenty or Twenty Cloud: your data, your server.

PRICING
Viginti is free to download and free for everyday CRM work: browse and search everything, use the dashboard, read cached data offline, complete tasks and create records while online - forever, no subscription required.

Viginti Pro unlocks the rest: editing, deleting and offline changes, push, widgets, Shortcuts that change your CRM, scanners, voice notes and AI, meeting prep and Live Activity, the map, saved views, advanced filters, calendar sync, attachments, exports and multiple workspaces.

Start with a 14-day free trial. Then EUR 3.99/month or EUR 29.99/year (save approx. 37%). Prices are shown in your local currency. Auto-renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Cancel anytime - your local CRM data and saved views are never deleted when a subscription ends.

GETTING STARTED
1. Connect your self-hosted Twenty or Twenty Cloud.
2. Browse instantly, online or offline.
3. Go Pro whenever you like - with a 14-day free trial.

Viginti is an independent, third-party native client built for the Twenty CRM platform and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Twenty. "Twenty CRM" is a trademark of its respective owner.
